control_failures.control_label: control of freeboard, beach width and decant

facts.hazard_release: fire, toxic exposure, corrosive contact, detonation
facts.title: vendor notification - premature wear on TANK-CLASS-P

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 1 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control IMPOUNDMENT_FREEBOARD_CONTROL: the control of freeboard, beach width and decant was in place but did not perform, and the ICAM investigation classified this as a task or environmental condition.

recommendations: Confirm at the next critical control verification that the control of freeboard, beach width and decant on TK-7104 and LT-7104 performs as designed.
response.sequence: Work was under way in operating an impoundment, specifically inspecting embankments and instrumentation. TK-7104 (product storage tanks) is in service for export product storage. The task proceeded during cleaning and preparation while the control of freeboard, beach width and decant was in place but did not perform. The chemical energy involved is held as hydrocarbon, and the recorded presentation was fire, toxic exposure, corrosive contact, detonation.
response.summary: On 22 July 2020 the original equipment manufacturer issued an advisory affecting TK-7104 and LT-7104 at Cape Verity Export Terminal.
